selection.rationale: Tie at the top of the valid population (the canonical ECON-T3 motivating case): two rows share the raw OOS-Sharpe max 1.4083 and are byte-identical on every metric (oos_ann_return 0.1172, max_drawdown -0.0850, n_trades 387) -- they are the same S6_hmm_stress / P2 / L0 strategy under two HMM probability thresholds (T4_hmm_0.5 vs T4_hmm_0.7) that bind to the same realised positions over this OOS window. ECON-T3 steps 1-4 cannot separate them and step 5 (lexicographic signal_code) is degenerate because the signal_code is identical; the published winner takes the lower threshold T4_hmm_0.5 (the first row in tournament order, ridx 1459 < 1462). Either choice yields the identical strategy series, so the selection is well-defined in outcome. Grid: committed daily L{0,1,5,10,21,63}, 2,036 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.7186.
